skills.instruction: Diagnose only barriers supported by the current DOM and measured evidence. Quote a valid selector and observable cause; omit unsupported recommendations.
Apply the smallest selector-scoped HTML or CSS change that addresses grounded evidence. Preserve content, URLs, behavior, layout structure and scripts.

Repair bounded semantic components with complete observed evidence. Root-cause groups partition operations exactly once; dependencies use existing selectors and an acyclic graph. Preserve native contracts, content order and recognizable original design.
